summary: Robot integration & mission-claim backend testing complete. 22/22 new tests pass in ~46s against public preview URL. Covered: admin robot register/list/get/delete (auth-gated + api_key_hash never leaked), X-Robot-Key auth for /robot/status /robot/patrol /robot/detection (401 on missing/wrong key), auto mission creation from detection with correct source/robot_id/size/expires_at, points formula for all 4 sizes and object_count bonus (small/medium/large/multi + capped extra), admin simulate-detection increments total_detections/missions_generated and appears in /missions, mission claim/release/mine-claimed flow including 15-min reserved_until, 409 conflict for other user, 404 for missing mission, 400 for completed mission, and admin stats includes robots + robot_detections. Gemini vision returns ai_objects+ai_size correctly (variable latency 3-8s per call). Push relay returns 401 (placeholder key) but endpoint still returns 200 as expected — verified graceful failure via backend logs.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 1450+ lines — recommend splitting into modules (auth.py, missions.py, robots.py, admin.py) in a future iteration.
current_robot iterates over ALL robots doing bcrypt.checkpw per request — O(N) auth. Fine for MVP (<100 robots) but consider a prefix/lookup optimization at scale.
The unused key_hash computation inside current_robot (line ~257) adds ~250ms bcrypt overhead per robot request. Suggest removing it — it's dead code.
_notify_users_of_new_mission ignores notify_radius_miles (only uses `_ = (mlat, mlng, radius)`). Radius parameter is currently a no-op — fine as documented, but confirm intent in PRD.
seed_data_creation: Created transient test users (TEST_robot_*@cleanrewards.com) and test robots (TEST_Robot_*, TEST_Init_*, TEST_ToDelete_*) plus one TEST_completed mission — all robots/missions cleaned up via delete endpoints in fixture teardown; users remain but are prefixed TEST_ for easy cleanup.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 1: 24 tests (test_cleanrewards_api.py). Iteration 2: 29 tests (test_admin_and_new_flows.py). Iteration 3: 22 tests (test_robot_integration.py). Total 75 backend tests passing. Robot-integration endpoints under /api/admin/robots/* and /api/robot/* (X-Robot-Key auth) all verified. Mission claim/release uses db.mission_claims collection with TTL on reserved_until. Points formula: small=50, medium=100, large=250, multi=400; +25*min(object_count-1, 6) bonus when size != multi. Gemini vision (via emergentintegrations LlmChat + gemini-2.5-flash) works — detection endpoint takes 3-8s. Push relay expected to return 401 (placeholder EMERGENT_PUSH_KEY) and endpoint still returns 200. If UI is added, verify testID attributes on robot admin screens.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no issues found. Initial test run had 1 fixture-ordering false failure (test_get_robot_detail_initial asserted detections==[] but shared module-scoped robot fixture had already accumulated detections from earlier tests in the same worker under pytest-xdist LoadScopeScheduling). Fixed by making that test create its own dedicated robot. This was a test-side ordering issue, NOT an application bug.
